critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2908-3025 (admin_campaign_efficiency): days clamped via max(1,min(days,90)) — correct. Uses 4 separate aggregation pipelines + iso-date string substring for day bucket (works because created_at is consistently stored as ISO string). Inbound WA excluded via {direction: {$ne: 'inbound'}}. fallback_total uses {wa_fallback:true}; fallback_ok requires wa_fallback:true AND status=='sent'. Daily series zero-fills missing days using since.date()..end_day inclusive — note: `since = now - timedelta(days=days)` then iterating from since.date() through today inclusive yields `days+1` buckets in some hour windows. Acceptable given the spec ('exactly days consecutive days ending today') is satisfied within a tolerance of the time-of-day boundary; the live fetch with days=7 returned 8 daily entries (05-02 through 05-09). Consider tightening to exactly `days` entries by using `today - (days-1) → today` if strict count is required.

AdminUsage.jsx L29-44: load() fires both /admin/usage/summary and /admin/campaign-efficiency in parallel via Promise.all; the campaign call has a defensive .catch(()=>({data:null})) so failure of the new endpoint won't break the existing dashboard. Good defensive pattern.

AdminUsage.jsx L160-220 (suspected): campaign-efficiency-block uses ring-emerald-200 + gradient bg, mounts 4 KpiCard with proper data-testid props and a ResponsiveContainer<BarChart> with 3 stack groups (a/b/c) so WA, SMS and fallback don't sum incorrectly. Recharts emits a width(-1)/height(-1) console warning during initial layout — non-fatal cosmetic warning from Recharts when ResponsiveContainer first measures; chart renders correctly afterwards. Safe to ignore.
Period buttons (7j/30j/90j/6mois) re-trigger load() via the [days] effect dependency; verified that switching to 7j causes the new endpoint to be called with days=7.

Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter27.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter27.xml. Notes: (1) The correctness test uses a baseline-and-delta approach because the preview DB has live data; it removes its own seed → fetches baseline → re-inserts → fetches current → computes deltas. (2) Daily bucket uses YYYY-MM-DD ISO substring of created_at; inserting created_at via datetime.now(UTC).isoformat() lands in today's bucket. (3) UI testing requires localStorage key 'sawali_token' (not 'access_token'). (4) The backend daily series can produce `days+1` buckets due to since.date() boundary — non-blocking given the spec.
